C0862.title: Top 10 Ransomware Gangs in 2023 Adopt Multi-Extortion Tactics
C0862.summary: A January 2024 disclosure report reveals that the ten most active ransomware gangs in 2023 added DDoS attack threats to their existing dual-extortion playbook of file encryption and data theft, forming a multi-extortion model. Some groups also employed an encrypt-less leak-only approach, intensifying pressure on victims.

references.title: Deadly Ransom: Unveiling the Top 10 Ransomware Gangs of 2023
